name: Claude CLI
description: Delegate AI tasks to the Anthropic Claude CLI running on your local machine.

config_fields.label: Default Device ID
config_fields.description: Device to use by default (leave blank for auto-selection)

config_fields.label: Default Timeout (seconds)
config_fields.description: Maximum time to wait for a Claude response (AI responses may be slow)

config_fields.label: Default Model
config_fields.description: Default Claude model to pass to the CLI (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6). Leave blank to use CLI default.

config_fields.label: Allowed Working Directories
config_fields.description: Comma-separated list of directories Claude CLI is permitted to access

config_fields.label: Execution Profile
config_fields.description: Controls default risk tolerance for Claude CLI operations

setup_instructions.title: Install the Claude CLI
setup_instructions.content: Run 'npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code' on each device. Verify with 'claude --version'.

setup_instructions.title: Enter your Anthropic API Key
setup_instructions.content: Paste your Anthropic API key above. It will be stored encrypted and used to authenticate Claude CLI calls.

setup_instructions.title: Connect a Native Device
setup_instructions.content: Ensure at least one native device is registered and online in the Devices panel.

setup_instructions.title: Test the Connection
setup_instructions.content: Ask an agent to run 'claude_check_runtime' to confirm the CLI is reachable on your device.
